mapper.sql: p.person_id, p.name, p.id_card, p.phone, p.gender, p.post_name, p.cert_name, p.cert_no, p.entry_date, p.remark, p.creator
mapper.select: select , r.id as rel_id, r.audit_status, r.auditor, to_char(r.audit_time, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') as audit_time from cbs.t_contractor_person r join cbs.t_person p on p.person_id = r.person_id where r.contractor_id = #{contractorId} and r.open_status = true and p.open_status = true order by r.create_time desc limit #{limit} offset #{offset}
select count(*) from cbs.t_contractor_person r join cbs.t_person p on p.person_id = r.person_id where r.contractor_id = #{contractorId} and r.open_status = true and p.open_status = true

sql.where:
p.open_status = true
and (p.name like concat('%', #{kw}, '%') or p.id_card like concat('%', #{kw}, '%') or p.phone like concat('%', #{kw}, '%'))
and not exists ( select 1 from cbs.t_contractor_person r where r.person_id = p.person_id and r.contractor_id = #{excludeContractorId} and r.open_status = true )

mapper.select:
select from cbs.t_person p
order by p.create_time desc limit #{limit} offset #{offset}
select from cbs.t_person p where p.person_id = #{id} and p.open_status = true
mapper.insert: insert into cbs.t_person (person_id, name, id_card, phone, gender, post_name, cert_name, cert_no, entry_date, remark, creator, open_status) values (#{p.person_id}, #{p.name}, #{p.id_card}, #{p.phone}, #{p.gender}, #{p.post_name}, #{p.cert_name}, #{p.cert_no}, #{p.entry_date}, #{p.remark}, #{p.creator}, true)
mapper.update: update cbs.t_person set name = #{p.name}, id_card = #{p.id_card}, phone = #{p.phone}, gender = #{p.gender}, post_name = #{p.post_name}, cert_name = #{p.cert_name}, cert_no = #{p.cert_no}, entry_date = #{p.entry_date}, remark = #{p.remark} where person_id = #{p.person_id} and open_status = true
update cbs.t_person set open_status = false where person_id = #{id}
